units.source_text: 正在唱和之时，许多王侯公卿一齐来南厢祝寿了。

en.t: While the poems were being exchanged, many princes and court nobles came together to the southern wing to offer birthday congratulations.

units.source_text: 紫姬的父亲式部卿亲王对玉鬘不快，

en.t: Prince Shikibukyo, Murasaki's father, was displeased with Tamakazura,

units.source_text: 本来不想参与，但念对方特地相邀，而自己与源氏又属至亲，未便故意疏远，终于在日暮之时来到。

en.t: and at first he had not wished to attend, but since she had specially invited him and he was closely related to Genji, he felt it would be improper to keep his distance on purpose, and finally arrived at dusk.

units.source_text: 髭黑大将则得意扬扬，以女婿身份料理贺寿一切事宜，式部卿亲王看在眼里很不快意。

en.t: General Higekuro, meanwhile, was full of pride and handled every detail of the birthday celebration as the son-in-law, which Prince Shikibukyo found deeply displeasing.

units.source_text: 但他的两个外孙是髭黑之子、紫姬之甥，两方面都有关系，所以也起劲地帮办杂务。

en.t: But his two grandsons were Higekuro's sons and Murasaki's nephews, tying him to both sides, so he also helped energetically with the various arrangements.

units.source_text: 盛礼品的笼子四十具、盒子四十件，由中纳言夕雾带领所有亲近的子侄，一一搬运到源氏面前。

en.t: Forty baskets and forty boxes filled with gifts were carried one by one before Genji by Middle Counselor Yugiri, who led all the close young kinsmen.

units.source_text: 源氏赐众人饮酒，进用新菜煮成的肴馔。

en.t: Genji served wine to everyone and offered dishes cooked with the first spring greens.

units.source_text: 他面前陈列着四只沉香木制的方几，几上的杯盘都很精美可爱。

en.t: Before him stood four square stands made of aloeswood, and the cups and plates upon them were all exquisitely charming.

units.source_text: 因朱雀院患病尚未痊愈，故不召乐人奏乐。

en.t: Because the Retired Emperor Suzaku was still ill and had not yet recovered, no musicians were summoned to perform.

units.source_text: 但太政大臣已备办了琴笛之类的乐器。

en.t: Yet the Grand Minister had already prepared instruments such as zithers and flutes.

units.source_text: 他说：“今天的祝寿仪式，可说是世间尽善尽美的了！”

en.t: He said, "Today's birthday ceremony may truly be called the height of perfection in this world."

units.source_text: 便将预先准备好的精良乐器取出，悄悄地演奏起来。

en.t: Then he brought out the fine instruments prepared in advance and quietly began to play.

units.source_text: 诸人各择一种乐器，

en.t: Each person chose an instrument,

units.source_text: 就中和琴是太政大臣当作第一名器而秘藏的，他自己正是这乐器的名手，今天聚精会神地弹奏起来，

en.t: and among them the wagon was a treasured instrument that the Grand Minister kept as the finest of its kind; he himself was a master of it, and today he played with complete concentration,

units.source_text: 其音美妙无比，使得别人不敢再弹此琴。

en.t: producing tones of incomparable beauty, so that no one else dared to play that zither afterward.

units.source_text: 源氏要右卫门督柏木也用和琴弹奏一曲，柏木固辞，强而后可。

en.t: Genji asked Kashiwagi, Captain of the Right Gate Guard, to play a piece on the wagon as well; Kashiwagi firmly declined, but yielded after being pressed.

units.source_text: 他弹得非常高明，竟不亚于乃父。

en.t: He played with extraordinary skill, not at all inferior to his father.

units.source_text: 听者都很感动，极口赞叹。

en.t: All who listened were deeply moved and praised him to the utmost.

units.source_text: 他们都说：无论何事，都贵有家学渊源，但如此善于继承父业，真乃世无其例。

en.t: They all said that in every art a family tradition is precious, but that such a brilliant inheritance of a father's craft was truly without equal in the world.

units.source_text: 中国传来的乐器，各调各有一定的手法，因此反而容易学会。

en.t: Instruments brought from China have fixed techniques for each mode, and for that reason are comparatively easy to learn.

units.source_text: 但这和琴初无定法，全凭心灵，例如随手拨弦的“清弹”，便具备各种乐器的音调，其美妙不可思议。

en.t: But this wagon has no fixed method at all and depends entirely on the player's spirit; for example, the free plucking called "clear playing" contains the tones of many instruments, and its beauty is wondrous beyond understanding.

units.source_text: 后来太政大臣把琴弦放得很宽，调子降得很低，弹出含有许多音响的曲调。

en.t: Later the Grand Minister loosened the strings widely, lowered the tuning, and played a melody filled with many resonances.

units.source_text: 而柏木则用非常明朗的调子，弹出娇媚可爱的声音。

en.t: Kashiwagi, by contrast, used a very bright mode and drew out a graceful, charming sound.

units.source_text: 诸亲王听了，无不吃惊，他们料不到柏木的技术如此高明。

en.t: All the princes who heard him were astonished, for they had not expected Kashiwagi's technique to be so accomplished.

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王弹七弦琴。

en.t: Prince Hotaru, Minister of War, played the seven-string zither.

units.source_text: 这张琴本来保藏在宜阳殿内，是历代第一名器。

en.t: This zither had originally been kept in the Giyoden Hall and was the finest famed instrument handed down through the generations.

units.source_text: 桐壶院晚年，一品公主擅长此道，桐壶院即将此琴赐与。

en.t: In the later years of the Kiritsubo Emperor, the First-Rank Princess excelled in this art, and the emperor bestowed the zither upon her.

units.source_text: 太政大臣欲使源氏的四十寿筵尽善尽美，特向一品公主请得此琴。

en.t: Wanting Genji's fortieth-birthday banquet to be perfect in every way, the Grand Minister specially borrowed this zither from the First-Rank Princess.

units.source_text: 源氏想起此琴历代相传的史迹，回忆往昔，不胜依恋。

en.t: Genji thought of the history by which this zither had been passed down through the ages, remembered the past, and was overcome with longing.

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王也酒后感伤，流泪不止。

en.t: Prince Hotaru, Minister of War, also grew sentimental after drinking and could not stop his tears.

units.source_text: 他察知源氏的心情，便将琴呈上。

en.t: Sensing Genji's feelings, he presented the zither to him.

units.source_text: 源氏此时满怀感慨，无法排遣，便取过琴来，弹了一支珍奇的乐曲。

en.t: At that moment Genji was filled with emotion and unable to dispel it, so he took the zither and played a rare and marvelous piece.

units.source_text: 这管弦合奏虽然规模不大，却是一个趣味无穷的夜会。

en.t: Though this ensemble of strings and winds was not large in scale, it was an evening gathering of inexhaustible charm.

units.source_text: 最后召唤唱歌队到阶前来演唱，诸人嗓音全都异常优美，从吕调移到律调。

en.t: Finally the singers were called to perform before the steps; all their voices were exceptionally beautiful as they moved from the ryo mode into the ritsu mode.

units.source_text: 唱到深夜，曲调逐渐变得温柔可爱了。

en.t: As they sang late into the night, the melody gradually became gentle and lovely.

units.source_text: 唱出催马乐《青柳》时，最为动听，连睡了的莺也都惊醒。

en.t: When they sang the saibara song "Green Willow," it was most delightful of all, enough to wake even the sleeping warblers.

units.source_text: 犒赏诸人的福物，按照私事格局，设计异常精美。

en.t: The auspicious gifts awarded to everyone were arranged in the manner of a private celebration and designed with exceptional elegance.
